config.prompt: Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.

reference.text:
A message that changes his life forever.
The lighthouse keeper, Jack, had been stationed on the rocky coast for five years. He had grown accustomed to the solitude, the rhythmic crash of the waves against the shore, and the occasional visit from a passing ship. But on this particular day, something caught his eye. A bottle, half-buried in the sand, its glassy surface glinting in the sunlight.

Curious, Jack picked up the bottle and examined it. It was old, the cork worn and weathered, but the paper inside was still intact. He carefully pulled out the message, and his eyes scanned the words scrawled on the page.

"Dear whoever finds this," the message read, "I am writing to you from the ship 'Eclipse', which has been lost at sea for over a year. We were on a voyage to the Far East when disaster struck. I am the only survivor, and I have been drifting on a lifeboat for months. I have seen wonders and horrors beyond your wildest imagination. "Dear whoever finds this," the letter began, "I am writing to you from the ship 'Eclipse', bound for the Americas. I am a young woman, traveling with my family to start a new life.
